user.title: Hyxi DMU
user.description: Enter the DMU's LAN address (give it a DHCP reservation). The local password is the one set in the HYXiPOWER app; the DMU currently accepts any value, but it must be sent to unlock the data channel.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Hyxi DMU
reconfigure.description: Update the DMU's LAN address or local password. The new address is checked on port 333 before the entry is reloaded.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the DMU on port 333.
